title: Quiet Kindness Lights the Meadow

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Can I lift the leaf cap without rushing or shouting loudly?

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Try a gentle scoop, the water will thank you quietly.

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: I feel the calm rising like a soft breeze now.

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Kindness whispers quietly, and the meadow’s glimmer appears gently.

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: The meadow shines now, gentle and bright for everyone!

dialogue.speaker: bramble
dialogue.text: Our quiet help truly helps the whole world today!
